properties.description: Reproduced after full working-tree checkpoint passed (120 server, 101 browser tests): immutable three-repository Preview fails PersoTemplate profile-fields.ts because comment is absent from an old Relational UI declaration. Materialization copied only repository-root node_modules, losing the template package's current local dependencies; root build also omitted explicit Relational UI/default-template prerequisites. Resolve package-scoped declared local dependencies within captured repositories and build owned contracts before consumers. Submission target 199 withdrawn untouched; exact candidate verification must pass before acceptance handoff.
properties.title: Isolated candidate resolves stale root packages instead of declared nested local dependencies
